subject: System Design
title: Anycast Routing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Anycast Routing.

hook.text: Cloudflare has one IP address for its entire network. Yet your traffic always reaches the nearest server. How?

buildup.text: Anycast announces the same IP address from multiple locations. Routers direct traffic to the nearest one.

discovery.text: This means no DNS-level routing is needed. The network itself picks the closest server for every packet.

twist.text: Anycast is tricky for TCP. If routing shifts mid-connection, packets hit a different server and the session breaks.

climax.text: Anycast is the backbone of modern CDNs and DNS providers, enabling instant global load balancing.

punchline.text: One IP, many servers — the network picks the nearest.

quiz.question: How does anycast routing work?
options: Same IP announced from multiple locations; routers pick the nearest
DNS resolves to the closest server
